title: Nasopharyngeal Microbiota Profiling of SARS-CoV-2 Infected Patients
author: De Maio, Posteraro, et al.
materials: Genomic DNA was extracted using the QIAGEN EZ1 Advanced XL system and the V5–V6 hypervariable region of the bacterial 16S rRNA gene was sequenced using an Illumina MiSeq V2 chemistry (2 × 250 bp) as described [11]. Sequencing data were processed for alignment and quality filtering in QIIME2 v2019.1 [15, 16], and representative amplicon sequence variants were obtained by the DADA2 algorithm [17] available at 10.1038/s41587-019-0209-9. Samples were rarefied to the minimum number of sequence reads obtained totally (range, 107,933–165,427) to perform subsequent analyses. Taxonomic annotation was performed using both VSEARCH [18] and SILVA database v132 [19]. Statistical tests, including Wilcoxon signed rank test and permutational analysis of variance (PERMANOVA) were performed in R software (R Foundation for Statistical Computing, version 3.6.0).

steps.title: Obtain ethical approval and collect samples
steps.instruction: Obtain ethical committee approval with a waiver of informed consent, then collect nasopharyngeal swabs from 40 patients (18 COVID‑positive, 22 COVID‑negative) between March 6 and March 9 2020.

steps.title: Diagnose COVID‑19 by RT‑PCR
steps.instruction: Test each nasopharyngeal swab for SARS‑CoV‑2 RNA using a real‑time RT‑PCR assay; specifically employ the Korean Ministry‑approved Allplex 2019‑nCoV assay (Arrow Diagnostics, Genova, Italy). Retain the same swabs for subsequent microbiota profiling.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA from swabs
steps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from each swab using the QIAGEN EZ1 Advanced XL system according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Amplify 16S V5‑V6 region
steps.instruction: Amplify the V5–V6 hypervariable region of the bacterial 16S rRNA gene (as described in reference [11]) from the extracted DNA.

steps.title: Sequence amplicons on Illumina MiSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence the amplified V5‑V6 region on an Illumina MiSeq using V2 chemistry with 2 × 250 bp paired‑end reads.

steps.title: Process sequencing data in QIIME2
steps.instruction: Import raw reads into QIIME2 v2019.1, perform alignment and quality filtering, then generate representative amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) using the DADA2 algorithm.

steps.title: Rarefy and annotate taxonomy
steps.instruction: Rarefy each sample to the minimum read count obtained across all samples (range 107,933–165,427 reads). Assign taxonomy to ASVs using VSEARCH and the SILVA database v132.

steps.title: Perform statistical analyses in R
steps.instruction: Conduct statistical comparisons using Wilcoxon signed‑rank test and PERMANOVA in R software version 3.6.0.
